note: BH-8530. An open ticket/* PR the author filter drops (UNKNOWN-AUTHOR) on more than this many consecutive UTC days raises ONE warn fleet_alert and one ALERTS line per streak (state in state/pr-author-unknown/). The daily UNKNOWN-AUTHOR line and alert stay as they are. Resolved through lib_env_apply gh-pr-list (_hpl_knobs_resolve); code fallback 2, and a value that is not a non-negative integer is 2. 0 = never warn.
